notes.title: [25.07.02 Release Notes] 1.2.0.00
notes.content:

🎫 Season 1 Season Pass
Season 1 Season Pass has begun!

Complete quests to earn Season Pass XP, level up, and claim various rewards!

Additional rewards are available depending on your subscription tier.

📅 Available: Jul 1, 2025 ~ Dec 31, 2025, 00:00 (UTC+0)

🎁 Rewards: 97 tiers in total

Basic: Free item rewards available

Premium: $5.99

Unlock Premium rewards

Includes Sombrero Hat Costume

Premium+: $7.99

Unlock Premium rewards

Includes Sombrero Hat Costume

Includes Black Boxing Gear Set

Fast-track to Season Pass Level 20 (instant unlock)

🛠️ \[Fixes & Improvements]

⚙️ System
Reduced wait time during stage matchmaking.
🗺️ Stages

General
Eliminated dust particles now disperse at different timings after the match ends.


Watch Out for the Vacuum!
Fixed vacuums not returning after falling off the map.


Toilet Racing
Fixed dust characters falling too slowly when thrown off track.


Dust Snake
Fixed camera being too high while spectating respawning characters.


Sinking Duck
Changed water cannon from arc to straight trajectory.


👤 Character
Fixed bug where punch intervals were shorter than intended.


🖥️ UI
Improved UI for Duck Stage reloading.

Improved Stun Gauge UI.

ESC key now closes pop-up windows.

Fixed issue with repeatedly sending party invites.

Updated arrow design for current player indicator.

Party members in Duo/Squad modes are now marked with group icons.

Lobby now shows Season Pass and Level Pass status.

notes.title: [25.03.19 Release Notes] 1.1.2.02
notes.content:
📢Patch Notes for Version 1.1.2.02 (Updated on March 19)

🛠️System

Social

 You can now leave notes about your friends.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751323/203354467c6130b2c7626402e76bc11b951b83fc.png
 Friend lists are now sorted by recent activity.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751323/09d8bc195ed0bc5af8c7b4a15968656270ceb27a.png
 A confirmation prompt has been added when deleting a friend.



💨Character

 Fixed an issue where objects or characters thrown after overlapping with walls would get stuck in the wall.


🌟Stage

General

 Reduced loading time for entering and transitioning between stages.
 Fixed an issue where the camera position became unnatural when switching from free-view to fixed-view in spectator mode.
 Adjusted the lighting in the living room area to remove streaky appearances.



Turn Off the Fan

 Fan rotation animations are now more natural.



Toy Cleanup

 Fixed an issue where the next-round qualifying teams were incorrectly displayed on the game results UI.



Precarious Plate Balancing

 Plates now tilt more slowly.
 Relaxed the elimination criteria so characters launched high into the air are not disqualified.
 Fixed an issue where characters could pass through plates.
 Fixed an issue where plates tilted in only one direction.



Sinking Duck

 Ducks now jump more responsively.
 Fixed unnatural duck movements during unstable network conditions.



🖥️UI

 Fixed an issue where the level of the first spectating target was displayed as 0.
 Added animations to certain UI elements.


🔊Sound

 Optimized background music in the lobby and stages.


Thank you for your support!
Geniesoft.inc

notes.title: [25.02.18 Release Notes] 1.1.2
notes.content:
📢 Patch Notes for Version 1.1.2 (Updated on February 18)

🛠️System

 Fixed an issue where the rocket launch animation repeated during the transition into the game after matchmaking.
 Multiplayer servers have been lightened.



🌟Stages

Dusty Snake

 Fixed an intermittent issue where players would not receive points when collecting dust fragments after respawning.
 Fixed a problem where the magnet item occasionally failed to activate its effect after being collected.



Turn off the Fan

 Addressed an issue where players pushing toy blocks would be overly affected by fan winds.



🖥️UI

 Fixed an issue where the stage player count text exceeded its designated area in certain language settings.


🎨Graphics

 Fixed an issue where some objects' surfaces appeared blurry.


🔊Sound

 Resolved intermittent instability in stage sound playback.


Thank you for your support.
Geniesoft.inc

notes.title: [25.02.10 Release Notes] 1.1.1
notes.content:
📢This is the patch history for version 1.1.1, which was patched on February 10.

🛠️System

 Fixed an issue where party members were not occasionally displayed with arrows after matchmaking and connecting to the server.



🌟Stage

Dust Snake

 🧹The Dust Snake stage has been added.
 🟡Collect dust scattered on the carpet to earn points and grow your tail. Win by scoring the most points!
 ⚠️Be careful not to touch your head to an opponent's tail, or you'll lose both points and your tail.
 🎁Pick up items during the game to turn the tide!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751323/5e95ba3555fd256f18c90f2159d0757a4d4f2584.gif


Color Chaos

 🖍️The Color Chaos stage has been added.
 🤝This stage is a team-based game.
 🌈Move while holding a crayon to color the stage.
 🏆Paint the stage in your team's color to claim victory!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751323/39aa99dc8c6426420a84c31eda51f2adc4d0994b.gif


Sinking Ducks

 🦆The Sinking Ducks stage has been revamped.
 📍The starting positions of players have been reorganized.
 💦Toys that shoot water cannons periodically have been placed at both ends of the bathtub.
 🌪️Tornadoes disrupting players' movement are now placed inside the bathtub.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751323/2c82fd8e94f079dbc3ca853af5c5935968c3de78.gif


Toilet Racing

🚽Fixed an issue where characters were occasionally not rescued after falling while being held.


Don’t Want to Fall!

 🧼The push force of gargling bubbles has been reduced.




🔊Sound

 Added sound effects to the Sinking Ducks stage.

 🦆Duck jumps
 💦Duck water cannon firing
 🚢Ship water cannon firing



Thank you for your support.
Geniesoft.inc

notes.title: [25.01.22 Release Notes] 1.1.0
notes.content:
This is the patch history for version 1.1.0, which was patched on January 22.

[System]

Social Features Added

 You can now add friends using in-game Battle Tags.
 BattleTags appear on the Preferences screen or when you click the Social button.
 You can invite friends to join your party.
 You can play with friends in parties.




[Stage]

Watch Out for the Vacuum

 If you were sucked into a vacuum cleaner and the location you escaped to was outside the play area, you will respawn in the play area. 

Multiple additional stages are currently in preparation.



[UI]

 Social feature-related UI has been added.


Thank you for your support.
Geniesoft.inc

notes.title: [24.12.12 Release Notes] 1.0.9
notes.content:
This is the patch history for version 1.0.9, which was patched on December 12th.

[Stage]

Toy Cleanup

 Fixed an issue where players occasionally failed to join a team and fell off the map.
 Rockets are flying chaotically! You can now ride rockets by interacting with the rocket toy.
 Fixed an issue where the bomb toy failed to push characters effectively.




[Character]

 Characters now fly more dynamically when thrown by other players.



[UI]

 Game concept art is now displayed on the loading screen.
 Fixed an issue where the first player’s level was displayed as 0 during spectating.


Thank you for your continued support!
Geniesoft.inc

notes.title: [24.11.22 Release Notes] 1.0.8
notes.content:
This is the patch history for version 1.0.8, which was patched on November 22th.

[System]

 Fixed an issue where the level of players being spectated was displayed as 1.
 Fixed an issue where the level of the winning player was displayed as 1.



[Stages]

Fish on the Cutting Board

 Fixed an issue where the stage would not clear even after meeting the requirements.

Sinking Duck

 The duck boat’s attack now follows a parabolic trajectory.
 Holding down the attack button increases the throwing power of the water balloons.




[UI]

 The trajectory of the water balloons is now displayed in the Sinking Duck stage.
 The trajectory color changes based on the throwing power of the water balloons in the Sinking Duck stage.



[Languages]

 Added support for Indonesian.
 Added support for Vietnamese.


Thank you for your continued support!
Geniesoft.inc

notes.title: [24.11.20 Release Notes] 1.0.7
notes.content:
This is the patch history for version 1.0.7, which was patched on November 20th.

[System]

 Fixed an issue where clear data was miscalculated when claiming rewards after a match.
 Fixed an issue where the costume equipped in the lobby differed from the one displayed during 
     gameplay or in the reward screen.



[Stages]

Toy Cleanup

 Fixed an issue where toys were placed in the basket before the match started,
     resulting in incorrect team scores at the beginning of the game.

Toilet Racing

 Improved so that characters no longer get stuck when passing through toilet paper rolls.

Don’t Wanna Fall!

 Reduced the pushing force of the mouthwash against characters.
 Shortened the interval at which the mouthwash pushes characters.

Burning Corn Showdown

 Fixed an issue where players occasionally escaped beyond the map.




[UI]

 Fixed an issue where the focusing border on wardrobe costumes would display incorrectly.


Thanks as always for supporting us!
Geniesoft.inc

notes.title: [24.11.14 Release Notes] 1.0.6
notes.content:
Patch Notes for Version 1.0.6 (November 14)
[SYSTEM]

 Added outline display system for grabbable objects
 Added costume preview in the lobby wardrobe

[STAGES]

Watch Out for the Vacuum

 Added vacuum attack patterns
 Wide-range fan-shaped suction
 Stationary rotating suction
 Fixed an issue where 'wind' effect wasn't showing during suction effects

Fish on the Cutting Board

 Reduced the number of anchovy spawns
 Fixed an issue where additional anchovies were spawning when dust character cleared with anchovy

Sinking Duck

 Water cannon charge gauge now deactivates upon elimination

Burning Corn Battle

 Reduced the force with which characters can push popcorn
 Fixed characters not reacting to unthrown popcorn

Don't Want to Fall In!

 Reduced the force of mouthwash pushing dust characters
 Increased the number of bubbles in gargle patterns


[CHARACTERS]

 Quick recovery from stun now possible using keyboard and mouse inputs
 Added ability to throw stunned characters in precise trajectories proportional to charge time

[UI]

 Added quick recovery guide display when characters are stunned
 Added outline display for grabbable objects when grabbing characters
 Added trajectory and landing point guides when throwing objects
 Fixed UI issue where "Failed" was occasionally displayed after successfully completing toy cleanup

Thank you for your continued support!
Geniesoft.inc

notes.title: [24.11.01 Release Notes] 1.05
notes.content:
Here are the patch notes for version 1.05, updated on November 1.

[System]

 Displays a message when the game is offline.
 Fixed an issue where the server region would display incorrectly after re-accessing the settings screen, even if a different region was selected.



[Stages]

 Fan Stage

 Fixed an issue where characters could overcome the fan’s wind force by rolling.

Toy Cleanup Stage

 Fixed an issue where AI characters would stop moving when standing on a basket.

Sink Stage

 Fixed an issue where the mouthwash near the drain would not push characters.
 Added new obstacle patterns and increased difficulty.

Stovetop Stage

 Modified so that corn no longer spawns on the burner.
 Adjusted AI behavior to avoid targeting corn located on the burner.
 Fixed an issue where AI characters would stop moving.
 Changed the number of corn pieces characters lose upon contact with the burner: 1/3 piece → 1/2 piece.
 Fixed an issue where the camera could view outside the world bounds.




[Characters]

 AI improvements

 Improved intelligence to hinder the first-place character.
 Reduced instances of attacking empty space.

 Object outlines are being worked on for items that can be picked up. [In Progress] [On Hold]
 Fixed an issue where the camera position was affected by other characters.



[Language]

 Localization of the right-click guide for pickable objects is underway. [In Progress] [On Hold]



[UI]

 Right-click guide for pickable objects is being worked on. [In Progress] [On Hold]


Thank you for your continued support!
Geniesoft.inc

notes.title: DUSTY DERBY IS NOW OUT IN EARLY ACCESS!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that Dusty Derby has officially launched in Early Access!

What’s Included:
In this Early Access release, you’ll be able to enjoy:

 Three home-themed areas: the living room, bathroom, and kitchen.
 Nine different stages for a fun battle royale party experience.
 Character customization with various costumes.


Launch Discount:
To celebrate our Early Access launch, we’re offering a 20% discount for the first 14 days!

Share Your Thoughts:
We’d love to hear about your experience! Leave a review on the Dusty Derby Steam Store page and share your thoughts with the community.

Feedback & Suggestions:
Encountered any bugs or have ideas for new content? Join our Discord Server to chat directly with our game designers and developers, or head to the Community Hub to start a discussion and connect with other players!
